passages.text: “As for you, O son of man, prophesy against Gog and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel "son of man."
God commanded Ezekiel to prophesy against Gog.
God told Ezekiel to speak His words to Gog.
God said, "This is what the Lord GOD says."
God said, "I am against you, Gog."
Gog is the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
God addressed Gog directly as the leader of these nations.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה בֶן־ אָדָם֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א עַל־ גּ֔וֹג וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל׃

passages.text: I will turn you around, drive you along, bring you up from the far north, and send you against the mountains of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
I will turn you around.
I will drive you forward.
I will bring you up from the far north.
I will send you against the mountains of Israel.
passages.original: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְשִׁשֵּׁאתִ֔יךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִ֖יךָ מִיַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן וַהֲבִאוֹתִ֖ךָ עַל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then I will strike the bow from your left hand and dash down the arrows from your right hand.
passages.sermon: God speaks to Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.\r\nGod says, “I will strike the bow from your left hand.\r\nI will make the arrows fall from your right hand.”
passages.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י קַשְׁתְּךָ֖ מִיַּ֣ד שְׂמֹאולֶ֑ךָ וְחִצֶּ֕יךָ מִיַּ֥ד יְמִינְךָ֖ אַפִּֽיל׃

passages.text: On the mountains of Israel you will fall—you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to every kind of ravenous bird and wild beast.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Gog and his armies.
You will fall on the mountains of Israel.
All your troops will fall with you.
The nations with you will also fall.
I will give you to the birds.
Every kind of bird will eat you.
I will give you to the wild beasts.
The wild beasts will eat you.
passages.original: עַל־ הָרֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּפּ֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ אֲגַפֶּ֔יךָ וְעַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑ךְ לְעֵ֨יט צִפּ֧וֹר כָּל־ כָּנָ֛ף וְחַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה נְתַתִּ֥יךָ לְאָכְלָֽה׃

passages.text: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
The Lord GOD declares His will.
You will fall in the open field.
I, the Lord GOD, have spoken.
passages.original: עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה תִּפּ֑וֹל כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God says, "I will send fire on Magog."
Magog is a nation opposed to Israel.
God says, "I will also send fire on those who live safely in the coastlands."
These people feel secure.
God says, "They will know that I am the LORD."
God shows His power and authority to all.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּמָג֔וֹג וּבְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאִיִּ֖ים לָבֶ֑טַח וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So I will make My holy name known among My people Israel and will no longer allow it to be profaned. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is holy.
He is the Holy One in Israel.
He will make His holy name known among His people Israel.
He will not allow His holy name to be profaned anymore.
The nations will know that He is the LORD.
The nations will know that He is the Holy One in Israel.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֨ם קָדְשִׁ֜י אוֹדִ֗יעַ בְּתוֹךְ֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־ אַחֵ֥ל אֶת־ שֵׁם־ קָדְשִׁ֖י ע֑וֹד וְיָדְע֤וּ הַגּוֹיִם֙ כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קָד֖וֹשׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Yes, it is coming, and it will surely happen, declares the Lord GOD. This is the day of which I have spoken.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD is powerful and true.
The Lord GOD says, “It is coming.”
The Lord GOD says, “It will surely happen.”
This is the day I have spoken about.
This day will come as I promised.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְנִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה ה֥וּא הַיּ֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out, kindle fires, and burn up the weapons—the bucklers and shields, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.
passages.sermon:
The people who live in the cities of Israel will go out.
They will gather weapons.
They will collect bucklers and shields.
They will take bows and arrows.
They will gather clubs and spears.
They will burn these weapons in fires.
They will use the weapons as fuel.
They will do this for seven years.
passages.original: וְֽיָצְא֞וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י׀ עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּבִעֲר֡וּ וְ֠הִשִּׂיקוּ בְּנֶ֨שֶׁק וּמָגֵ֤ן וְצִנָּה֙ בְּקֶ֣שֶׁת וּבְחִצִּ֔ים וּבְמַקֵּ֥ל יָ֖ד וּבְרֹ֑מַח וּבִעֲר֥וּ בָהֶ֛ם אֵ֖שׁ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: They will not gather wood from the countryside or cut it from the forests, for they will use the weapons for fuel. They will loot those who looted them and plunder those who plundered them, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The people of Israel will not gather wood from the countryside.
They will not cut wood from the forests.
They will burn the weapons for fuel.
They will take goods from those who took from them.
They will plunder those who plundered them.
The Lord GOD declares this.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֨וּ עֵצִ֜ים מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְלֹ֤א יַחְטְבוּ֙ מִן־ הַיְּעָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י בַנֶּ֖שֶׁק יְבַֽעֲרוּ־ אֵ֑שׁ וְשָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת־ שֹׁלְלֵיהֶ֗ם וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת־ בֹּ֣זְזֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

passages.text: And on that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the Sea. It will block those who travel through, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking about Gog, the enemy of Israel.
On that day, God will give Gog a burial place in Israel.
This place will be in the Valley of the Travelers.
The Valley of the Travelers is east of the Sea.
This valley will block those who travel through it.
People will bury Gog there.
People will also bury all of Gog’s hordes there.
They will call this place the Valley of Hamon-gog.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אֶתֵּ֣ן לְגוֹג֩׀ מְקֽוֹם־ שָׁ֨ם קֶ֜בֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גֵּ֤י הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ קִדְמַ֣ת הַיָּ֔ם וְחֹסֶ֥מֶת הִ֖יא אֶת־ הָעֹֽבְרִ֑ים וְקָ֣בְרוּ שָׁ֗ם אֶת־ גּוֹג֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה וְקָ֣רְא֔וּ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃

passages.text: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.
passages.sermon: The house of Israel will bury them.\r\nThey will do this for seven months.\r\nThey will bury them to cleanse the land.
passages.original: וּקְבָרוּם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמַ֖עַן טַהֵ֣ר אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ שִׁבְעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I display My glory, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He will display His glory.
All the people in the land will bury the dead.
This act will give the people a good name.
They will become known on the day God shows His glory.
passages.original: וְקָֽבְרוּ֙ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לְשֵׁ֑ם י֚וֹם הִכָּ֣בְדִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: And men will be employed to continually pass through the land to cleanse it by burying the invaders who remain on the ground. At the end of the seven months they will begin their search.
passages.sermon:
Men will work in the land.
These men will go through the land again and again.
They will look for bodies left on the ground.
They will bury the invaders who remain.
They do this to cleanse the land.
They will keep searching for seven months.
At the end of seven months, they will begin their search again.
passages.original: וְאַנְשֵׁ֨י תָמִ֤יד יַבְדִּ֙ילוּ֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ מְקַבְּרִ֣ים אֶת־ הָעֹבְרִ֗ים אֶת־ הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְטַֽהֲרָ֑הּ מִקְצֵ֥ה שִׁבְעָֽה־ חֳדָשִׁ֖ים יַחְקֹֽרוּ׃

passages.text: As they pass through the land, anyone who sees a human bone will set up a pillar next to it, until the gravediggers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
passages.sermon:
People will travel through the land.
A person may see a human bone.
That person will place a marker beside the bone.
The marker will show where the bone is.
Gravediggers will come to that place.
The gravediggers will bury the bone.
They will bury it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
passages.original: וְעָבְר֤וּ הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרָאָה֙ עֶ֣צֶם אָדָ֔ם וּבָנָ֥ה אֶצְל֖וֹ צִיּ֑וּן עַ֣ד קָבְר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַֽמְקַבְּרִ֔ים אֶל־ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃

passages.text: (Even the city will be named Hamonah.) And so they will cleanse the land.
passages.sermon: The people will name a city Hamonah.\r\nThey will cleanse the land.
passages.original: וְגַ֥ם שֶׁם־ עִ֛יר הֲמוֹנָ֖ה וְטִהֲר֥וּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

passages.text: And as for you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Call out to every kind of bird and to every beast of the field: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great feast on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to the son of man.
He gave a command to the son of man.
The Lord told him to speak to every kind of bird.
He also told him to speak to every beast of the field.
The Lord said, "Gather together from all around."
"Come to the sacrifice I am preparing for you."
"This is a great feast on the mountains of Israel."
"You will eat flesh there."
"You will drink blood there."
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֨ה בֶן־ אָדָ֜ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אֱמֹר֩ לְצִפּ֨וֹר כָּל־ כָּנָ֜ף וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה הִקָּבְצ֤וּ וָבֹ֙אוּ֙ הֵאָסְפ֣וּ מִסָּבִ֔יב עַל־ זִבְחִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י זֹבֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ זֶ֣בַח גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּֽם׃

passages.text: You will eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as though they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls—all the fattened animals of Bashan.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Ezekiel, the son of man.
God commands him to call the birds and wild animals.
God prepares a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel.
God invites the birds and animals to this feast.
At this feast, you will eat the flesh of mighty men.
You will drink the blood of the princes of the earth.
These mighty men and princes are like rams, lambs, goats, and bulls.
All these animals are fattened animals from Bashan.
You will eat and drink as if these men were the fattened animals.
passages.original: בְּשַׂ֤ר גִּבּוֹרִים֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וְדַם־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּשְׁתּ֑וּ אֵילִ֨ים כָּרִ֤ים וְעַתּוּדִים֙ פָּרִ֔ים מְרִיאֵ֥י בָשָׁ֖ן כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: At the sacrifice I am preparing, you will eat fat until you are gorged and drink blood until you are drunk.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Ezekiel, the son of man.
God says He is preparing a sacrifice.
God addresses the birds and wild animals.
God says, "You will eat fat until you are full."
God says, "You will drink blood until you are drunk."
God says, "This will happen at the sacrifice I have made for you."
passages.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם־ חֵ֣לֶב לְשָׂבְעָ֔ה וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּ֖ם לְשִׁכָּר֑וֹן מִזִּבְחִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ זָבַ֥חְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And at My table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, of mighty men and warriors of every kind,’ declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He prepares a table.
You will eat at His table.
You will eat your fill.
You will eat horses.
You will eat riders.
You will eat mighty men.
You will eat every kind of warrior.
passages.original: וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֤ם עַל־ שֻׁלְחָנִי֙ ס֣וּס וָרֶ֔כֶב גִּבּ֖וֹר וְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: I will display My glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the judgment that I execute and the hand that I lay upon them.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God will show His glory to the nations.
All nations will see the Lord's glory.
The Lord will judge the nations.
All nations will see the Lord's judgment.
The Lord will act with power against the nations.
All nations will see the Lord's power.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ כְּבוֹדִ֖י בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָא֣וּ כָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְאֶת־ יָדִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֥מְתִּי בָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is the God of Israel.
God will act so that Israel knows Him.
From that day onward, Israel will know God is the LORD their God.
passages.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם מִן־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא וָהָֽלְאָה׃

passages.text: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their iniquity, because they were unfaithful to Me. So I hid My face from them and delivered them into the hands of their enemies, so that they all fell by the sword.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God sent the house of Israel into exile.
God did this because Israel sinned.
Israel was unfaithful to God.
God hid His face from Israel.
God gave Israel into the hands of their enemies.
All of Israel fell by the sword.
The nations will know these things.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֣וּ הַ֠גּוֹיִם כִּ֣י בַעֲוֺנָ֞ם גָּל֣וּ בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ־ בִ֔י וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַ֣ד צָרֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּפְּל֥וּ בַחֶ֖רֶב כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions, and I hid My face from them.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD of Israel.
God judged the people of Israel.
The people of Israel acted with uncleanness.
The people of Israel committed transgressions.
God dealt with them because of their uncleanness.
God dealt with them because of their transgressions.
God hid His face from them.
passages.original: כְּטֻמְאָתָ֥ם וּכְפִשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹתָ֑ם וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore Jacob from captivity and will have compassion on the whole house of Israel, and I will be jealous for My holy name.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He says, “Now I will act.”
I will bring Jacob back from captivity.
I will show compassion to the whole house of Israel.
I will protect the honor of My holy name.
I will be jealous for My holy name.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה עַתָּ֗ה אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־ שְׁבִית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְקִנֵּאתִ֖י לְשֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: They will forget their disgrace and all the treachery they committed against Me, when they dwell securely in their land, with no one to frighten them.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel once acted with disgrace and treachery against God.
God will bring them back to their own land.
They will live there in safety.
No one will make them afraid.
Then they will forget their shame.
They will forget all the ways they were unfaithful to God.
passages.original: וְנָשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲלוּ־ בִ֑י בְּשִׁבְתָּ֧ם עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֛ם לָבֶ֖טַח וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

passages.text: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them out of the lands of their enemies, I will show My holiness in them in the sight of many nations.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to Israel.
Israel had been scattered among many peoples.
Their enemies held them in foreign lands.
The Lord said He would bring Israel back from those peoples.
He would gather Israel out of the lands of their enemies.
The Lord would act in front of many nations.
He would show His holiness through Israel.
Many nations would see the Lord’s holiness in Israel.
passages.original: בְּשׁוֹבְבִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵֽאַרְצ֖וֹת אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְנִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי בָ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הַגּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, when I regather them to their own land, not leaving any of them behind after their exile among the nations.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is their God.
God sent them into exile among the nations.
God will gather them back to their own land.
God will not leave any of them behind.
They will know that God is the LORD their God.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם בְּהַגְלוֹתִ֤י אֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְכִנַּסְתִּ֖ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ אוֹתִ֥יר ע֛וֹד מֵהֶ֖ם שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And I will no longer hide My face from them, for I will pour out My Spirit on the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the God of Israel.
He says, “I will not hide My face from them anymore.
I have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel.
I, the Lord GOD, have declared this.”
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ אַסְתִּ֥יר ע֛וֹד פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁפַ֤כְתִּי אֶת־ רוּחִי֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
